frames.title: Quick Review
frames.teacherCue: Have the student read the four previous-substep words. Tap or scoop only as needed, then briefly review the 7.2 concepts.

frames.title: What sound does ph make?
frames.teacherCue: Present the ph Letter-Sound Card. Practice ph-phone-/f/.

frames.title: Read words with ph
frames.teacherCue: Build/read the source-provided ph examples one at a time. Tap only as needed.

frames.title: Remember dge?
frames.teacherCue: Use fudge to review dge as a trigraph.

frames.title: Meet tch
frames.teacherCue: Present the tch Letter-Sound Card. Practice tch-catch-/ch/. Build catch and tap the three sounds.

frames.title: When do we use tch?
frames.text: tch is used directly after a short vowel.
frames.teacherCue: Ask whether the vowel in catch is long or short. Read stretch and scratch and discuss why tch is used rather than ch.

frames.title: Student Notebook
frames.text: Add ph to the Digraphs page with the keyword phone. Practice marking ph in phone.
frames.teacherCue: Complete the Sounds-section notebook entry for ph exactly as directed in the 7.3 source.

frames.title: Student Notebook
frames.text: Add tch to the Trigraphs page with the keyword catch. Practice marking tch in catch.
frames.teacherCue: Complete the Sounds-section notebook entry for tch exactly as directed in the 7.3 source.

frames.title: Build it bigger
frames.teacherCue: Build latch with Letter-Sound Cards, add -ed, then add un-. Have the student read the base word first and then the whole word.

frames.title: More ph/tch + affixes
frames.teacherCue: Use the source-provided examples with taught affixes.

frames.title: Coming next in 7.3
frames.teacherCue: Do not teach this frame in the first lesson unless the lesson sequence has reached the Greek combining-form introduction.
